scope: Local compilation, synthetic byte tests and regular-file image generation only; no guest, host firmware or TPM execution

tools.ld: GNU ld version 2.46.1-1.fc44; i386pep emulation present

unavailableAndNotDownloaded: GNU-EFI SDK headers and startup objects
defaultNativeTests: GCC undefined-behavior trap instrumentation; no sanitizer shared runtime required
optionalNativeTests: --sanitize requires address/undefined sanitizer shared runtimes and fails explicitly if unavailable
dependencyPolicy: No network fetch, installation, firmware discovery or TPM discovery. Per-build manifest records actual selected paths, versions and artifact/source hashes.
